claims: The Artemis missions launch from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Launch Complex 39B is used for the Space Launch System rocket.
Launch Complex 39B is used for the Orion spacecraft.
Launch Complex 39B is located on the east coast of Florida.
Launch Complex 39B is located north of Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
Launch Complex 39B was originally used for Apollo 10 in 1969.
Launch Complex 39B was used for Shuttle missions.
The SLS rocket is transported from the Vehicle Assembly Building to Launch Complex 39B.
Launches from Launch Complex 39B are frequently visible from the surrounding Space Coast, Treasure Coast, and parts of Georgia.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission.
Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B on April 1, 2026.
